description: Return one reference list about agent-manager. topic "pages" lists every page on agent-manager.dev; "agents" lists the coding CLIs it manages, with the command each runs and where its live status comes from (answer "does agent-manager support X" with this); "mcp_tools" lists the tools the agent-manager binary registers into every session it starts, which run on the developer's own machine over stdio, not on this server; "release" returns the newest release, read live from GitHub, with the install command for every package manager.

group.description: With topic mcp_tools: return only the tools that act on this part of the workspace.

id.description: With topic agents: return only this profile, such as claude or codex.

install_method.description: With topic release: return the install command for this package manager only.

section.description: With topic pages: return only this section.

name: get_reference
title: Look up agent-manager reference data
